# اُخْتُصِرَا (uḵtuṣirā) /ux.tu.sˤi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# اِخْتَصِرَا (iḵtaṣirā) /ix.ta.sˤi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
